ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the source report was ingested into the system

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Source folder or path where the report file was collected

num_channels.description: Number of channels used for the downlink session (from NumChannels)

satellite_id.description: Identifier of the satellite that performed the downlink (from Satellite)

ground_station.description: Ground station code where the session was acquired

station_unit_id.description: Identifier of the station unit that acquired the session (from StationUnitId)

acquisition_id.description: Acquisition identifier of the downlink session (from AcquisitionId)

publication_date.description: Date the session was published by the CADIP service (from PublicationDate)

downlink_orbit.description: Orbit number during which the downlink occurred (from DownlinkOrbit)

antenna_id.description: Identifier of the antenna used for the downlink (from AntennaId)

antenna_status.description: Whether the antenna operated nominally during the session (from AntennaStatusOK)

front_end_id.description: Identifier of the front-end processor used for the session (from FrontEndId)

retransfer.description: Whether the session data was delivered as a retransfer (from Retransfer)

front_end_status.description: Whether the front-end processor operated nominally (from FrontEndStatusOK)

planned_data_start.description: Planned start time of the data downlink (from PlannedDataStart)

planned_data_stop.description: Planned stop time of the data downlink (from PlannedDataStop)

downlink_start.description: Actual start time of the data downlink (from DownlinkStart)

downlink_stop.description: Actual stop time of the data downlink (from DownlinkStop)

downlink_status.description: Whether the downlink completed successfully (from DownlinkStatusOK)

delivery_push_status.description: Whether the delivery push of the session completed successfully (from DeliveryPushOK)

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced this record (e.g. CADIP_<station>_Sessions)

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service that provided the session, set to CADIP

station_id.description: CADIP station identifier (from StationId, defaulted per station when absent)

production_service_name.description: Name of the CADIP ground station service that provided the session

quality_infos.description: Per-channel transfer-frame quality metrics for the session (from the QualityInfo expansion)

Channel.description: Channel number the quality metrics apply to

AcquiredTFs.description: Total number of transfer frames acquired on the channel

SessionId.description: Acquisition session identifier the quality info belongs to

ErrorTFs.description: Number of transfer frames received with errors

CorrectedTFs.description: Number of transfer frames corrected by error correction

UncorrectableTFs.description: Number of transfer frames that could not be corrected

DataTFs.description: Number of data transfer frames acquired on the channel

ErrorDataTFs.description: Number of data transfer frames received with errors

CorrectedDataTFs.description: Number of data transfer frames corrected by error correction

UncorrectableDataTFs.description: Number of data transfer frames that could not be corrected

DeliveryStart.description: Start time of the delivery of the channel data

DeliveryStop.description: Stop time of the delivery of the channel data

TotalChunks.description: Total number of data chunks delivered for the channel

TotalVolume.description: Total data volume delivered for the channel in bytes
